title: NLP Text Analysis Using TF-IDF
summary: A text processing pipeline that transforms raw text into meaningful numerical features using NLP techniques and TF-IDF.
points: Built a text preprocessing workflow to prepare raw text for analysis and machine learning.
Applied lowercase conversion, punctuation cleaning, tokenization and stop word removal where appropriate.
Used TF-IDF vectorization to transform cleaned text into numerical features based on word importance.
Organized preprocessing steps into a consistent workflow to avoid repeating unnecessary transformations.
Explored how numerical text representations can support NLP tasks such as text classification and similarity analysis.
